authorization: Owner: do not stop until a breakthrough in any of math, physics, information science; continue exploring more problems; 48 hours; explore six problems concurrently, two per area; no token ceiling.
orchestration: Six in-session research workers, exactly two active problem slots per domain; replace solved-by-prior-work or concretely exhausted directions with a recorded, newly frozen target. No cron, launchd, old explorer requeue, old record edits, or automatic rewriting of past verdicts.

breakthrough_gate.claim: A complete solution or counterexample to an explicitly stated open target, or a materially new theorem/method with a demonstrated consequential delta against matched primary prior art.
required: Complete proof or independently checkable witness
Independent parent verification and hostile cross-vendor review
Primary-source comparison and explicit priority limits
No silent restriction of original quantifiers
insufficient: A restatement, encoding, mock certificate, or proof sketch
Model acceptance without checking the mathematical bridge

resource_contract.observed_host: Apple M3 Ultra, 28 CPUs, 96 GiB RAM, 188 GB free
resource_contract.rule: Use existing environments read-only; all new files, caches, copies, control fixtures and environments stay inside the lane. Retain fixtures; do not use auto-deleting TemporaryDirectory. Stop only owned processes cooperatively. Escalate measured memory/disk needs before exceeding targets. No new paid API fallback.

lanes.statement: Construct 55 pairwise block-disjoint resolvable Steiner triple systems on 57 labelled points; independently verify every class, pair and all 29260 triples.
lanes.first_obligation: A materially new representation: trades or coupled dynamic packings instead of repeating the frozen C19-complement or exhausted cyclic SAT models.

lanes.statement: For every group G of order n and word of length 2n-1, select n indices in increasing order whose product is identity; alternatively one exact counterexample refutes it.
lanes.first_obligation: Recheck ordered (not reorderable) primary status, then use a new normal-subgroup/ordered-product mechanism or exact counterexample search beyond the exhausted fixed-run families.

lanes.statement: For N_p(rho)=(1-p)rho+(p/3)(XrhoX+YrhoY+ZrhoZ), obtain a rigorous finite-block positive coherent-information witness or genuinely new capacity theorem improving matched prior art, with antidegradability and hashing controls.
lanes.first_obligation: Primary audit of the 0.194868 explicit certificate and 0.2029161 asymptotic claim; identify a finite-dimensional, independently certifiable construction beyond reproducing their ansatz.

lanes.statement: Construct a rank-three projector on seven qubits satisfying PEP=c_E P for every Pauli E of weight at most two, or prove no such projector exists; genuinely non-CWS representation required.
lanes.first_obligation: Recheck general-code bounds, derive a non-CWS projector obstruction or algebraic representation; no further excluded CWS graph enumeration.

lanes.statement: Construct a 512-bit truth table of weight 256 with every Walsh coefficient at most 28 in absolute value, or prove none exists.
lanes.first_obligation: Read the accepted one-type exclusion and three failed continuations; require a genuinely new whole-type or spectral/sign representation, not blind count/SAT retries. Seven types remain.

lanes.target: Robust SPR synthesis at degree seven and beyond
lanes.statement: Prove every robustly Hurwitz monic closed coefficient box of degree seven admits one exact-degree-seven numerator b with Re(b(iw)/a(iw))>0 for every box member and real w; alternatively an exactly certified stable interval box at any degree >=7 with no common numerator refutes the full conjecture.
lanes.first_obligation: Recheck primary status, then close the all-strata boundary-positivity obstruction or construct an exact alternating-contact certificate. Degree seven is explicitly a specialist case, not the full all-degree book claim.

evidence_contract: Each lane owns README.md, sources/, code/, evidence/, review/ inside its path. Freeze exact target/status/baseline/attack before substantial search. Record commands, versions, seeds, input/source hashes, actual runtime, positive and mutation controls. Keep written, finite-exact, numerical, Lean and novelty levels separate. Notify parent immediately of a candidate solution or concrete obstruction. Report checkpoints with claim, actual result, blocker and next bounded experiment. No build/lint/test suites mid-flight; run scientific experiments and narrowly targeted certificate smoke checks; consolidated verification follows the completed candidate.
preservation: All prior engine records, attack snapshots and continuation evidence remain unchanged. Parent owns shared indexes and this run directory; workers own only their lane. Replacement targets are separate subdirectories with explicit recorded transitions, not overwrite/rebranding of failed claims.
